name: 01-economy
prompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Generate ONE detailed desktop WEBSITE page prototype, landscape 1440x1100. Reference image is an illustration STYLE reference ONLY: retain its warm clean colour-plane illustrations, frontal architecture with shallow depth, charming DRAWN people, soft restrained shading. No photorealism, sketches, isometric game worlds, sombre realism. Same Estimador family: pine #234c40 typography and buttons, paper #f5f3ea, cream panels, mineral blue and sage with sparing clay accent. Manrope-like sans-serif throughout all headings/interface, no giant serif or magazine poster. Small plain "estimador.pt" wordmark at upper left, navigation "População Economia Desporto Eleições Sobre". Don't redesign logo. Small "Protótipo visual" badge. Normal 48px rectangular buttons, thin borders, comfortable compact layout. Illustrations have enough concrete subject context to be recognised, never cryptic tiny icons: a fragment of a meaningful setting, 160–240px wide near section entry, not a massive illustrated hero. Serious content is primary. Keep illustration OUTSIDE charts, table data, controls. No invented real statistics, parties, club badges, forecasts, dates, source citations, functional claims or live data. Conceptual data/tool areas must say "Exemplo de interface". Do not add decorative mosaic blocks or marginal slogans. This is a credible product page, not a homepage or a collage. PAGE: ECONOMY, a useful current paused-state landing page. Distinctive composition: a compact horizontal title band, followed by an asymmetric reading dashboard: broad explanatory content left, narrow source/methodology rail right. Title "A economia, à escala do dia a dia." short sentence "Perceber o que os indicadores medem — e o que deixam de fora." Status pill "Painel em pausa"; compact message "Sem valores atuais publicados nesta prévia." To right of heading a ~210px illustration: section of a recognisable Portuguese street with small grocery awning and counter below apartment window, drawn shopkeeper handing a bag to a customer. Enough street detail to say local economic life, no endless plant detail or entire city. Below, three topic selector tabs "Preços" "Trabalho" "Atividade", selected Preços. Broad cream educational feature "Quando a inflação abranda, os preços descem?" with 3 short calm text blocks explaining lower inflation means slower price growth, not necessarily falling prices. Beside explanation a small simple drawn shopping basket and receipt, NOT statistical chart. Below two compact explanatory links "O que entra no cabaz?" and "Porque muda a taxa?" with short descriptions. Right rail "Antes de comparar" with labelled checklist "Período", "Unidade", "Revisões"; source link text "Fontes e metodologia" not fabricated citation. Bottom thin paused indicators table row names Inflação / Emprego / Atividade, values em dash, status Em pausa. Date-free. Main action "Ler a metodologia". Tone grown-up curious, not alarm/error page or store website. Render readable meaningful short Portuguese copy, body content rather than illustration dominates.
